case: An edit citing a nursery catalog for a height: the routine finds the figure in a registered source and cites that; where it can't, the change is not used.

assume.https://www.example-nursery.com/catalog/: A nursery catalog page giving a spread of 6–12 in and calling growth fast. No registered source.
assume.https://plants.usda.gov/plant-profile/CA: Gives a spread of 0.5–1 ft and no growth rate.

items.reason: The catalog isn't a registered source, but USDA PLANTS gives the same spread, 0.5–1 ft; it is set and cited to USDA PLANTS instead.
No registered source gives a growth rate for camas, and a nursery catalog can't be cited. If you have seen it spread quickly yourself, send that as an observation.
